name: World Wide Web public FTP release
summary: In August 1991 Tim Berners-Lee made the World Wide Web software and files freely downloadable and announced them online, letting anyone on the Internet try it.
description: Early WorldWideWeb files, browser/server software and hypertext service announced for anonymous FTP access.
